postings.title: AI scientist for Quantum Computing (Massy)
postings.description:
About Quandela:

Quandela is a European deeptech company building modular, scalable and energy-efficient spin-photonic quantum computers.

We develop the full quantum computing stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to control systems, software and applications. Our platforms are available through the cloud and as on-premises systems.

Our ambition is to build fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation.

The role:

We are looking for an AI Scientist to join Quandela’s AI and Quantum Machine Learning team in Massy (near Paris)

You will develop and evaluate machine-learning approaches for quantum computing, covering both:

- AI for quantum systems, including calibration, control, decoding for quantum error correction;
- quantum and hybrid machine learning, including rigorous comparisons with state-of-the-art classical methods, using MerLin, Quandela's framework for quantum machine learning.

You will work on research with colleagues across AI, quantum algorithms, software, product and hardware.

The Massy team is a central part of Quandela’s AI activities. This role therefore offers significant ownership and the opportunity to help shape and grow the team over time.

What You'll Do:

- Design, implement and train machine-learning and quantum machine-learning models.
- Develop AI methods to improve the calibration, control and performance of quantum systems.
- Benchmark classical, quantum and hybrid methods using meaningful baselines and evaluation metrics.
- Contribute actively to the development of the MerLin framework.
- Contribute to publications and collaborations with academic partners, including research ecosystem.
- Present your work internally and at scientific conferences and technical events.
- Help define Quandela’s future AI research directions and mentor junior researchers as the team grows.

Requirements

What we are looking for:

We are looking for an AI scientist, or an experienced industry practitioner with an equivalent background, who is eager to apply state-of-the-art classical machine-learning methods to scientific and engineering challenges in quantum computing. The role is primarily focused on using AI to improve quantum technologies, while also providing opportunities to develop and investigate quantum and hybrid machine-learning models.

- PhD + 3 years of experience or equivalent industrial R&D experience in machine learning.
- Strong foundations in modern machine learning, experimental methodology and model evaluation.
- Excellent scientific programming skills, particularly in Python and common machine-learning frameworks.
- Experience taking research ideas from initial exploration to robust implementation.
- Interest in working on both longer term research and concrete product problems.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work autonomously within a focused, multidisciplinary team.
- Professional fluency in English.

Bonus Points

- Previous experience applying AI to physical systems, scientific computing, hardware control or experimental data.
- Knowledge of quantum computing, quantum machine learning or photonic quantum technologies.
- Experience mentoring junior researchers or helping define technical research directions.

Benefits

- Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience and expectations

- Profit-sharing & company savings plan
- 100% health coverage (Alan)
- 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
- Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
- Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

Process:

- Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45')
- Hiring Manager Interview (45' - 60')
- Reference checks
- Technical discussion and presentation of previous research work
- Meeting with the team
- Offer

Beyond That:
At Quandela, we value scientific curiosity, experimentation and collaboration. If you're passionate about quantum optics, spin physics and quantum technologies, we'd love to hear from you, even if you don't meet every listed requirement.

If you're excited by the challenge of turning scientific ideas into demonstrations, advancing the building blocks of future quantum computing systems and working alongside physicists, engineers and theorists, let's talk.

postings.title: Strategy & CEO Office intern
postings.description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.

Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Job Description

Quandela is hiring a Strategy & CEO Office Intern for a six-month internship starting between January and March 2027. The position is open to final-year and gap-year students.

You will work closely with the Chief of Staff and regularly interact with members of the Executive Committee (especially CEO and COO) and many other teams (Ops, Finance, Sales, Communication, Marketing). Your role will be to help Quandela understand a fast-moving market, make informed strategic choices and execute selected company-wide priorities, from fundraising and M&A to international growth, process implementation and AI adoption.

Like the company’s priorities, your projects will evolve during the internship. You may investigate a new market one month, help prepare a major executive meeting the next, and then take ownership of a cross-functional strategic initiative. You will combine rigorous analysis with hands-on execution and will progressively lead projects from initial question to final recommendation or delivery.

The role combines two types of work:

- High-impact strategic projects, selected according to Quandela’s priorities and your strengths.
- Recurring CEO Office responsibilities, including market intelligence, board reports and preparation for key executive meetings.

What you could work on

Strategic projects

- Support fundraising strategy through investor landscape mapping, strategic analysis and preparation of investor and board communications.
- Assess priority markets, geographies, partnerships and growth opportunities, and turn the analysis into clear recommendations for leadership.
- Screen potential acquisition targets across Quandela’s value chain and support selected M&A assessments.
- Contribute to company-wide priorities such as strategic planning, OKRs, internal AI adoption and operational design.

Market and competitive intelligence

- Monitor competitors, technologies, customers, partnerships, funding rounds and major industry developments.
- Analyze how the quantum computing market is evolving across cloud, HPC, research and enterprise applications.
- Produce concise, decision-oriented briefs and presentations for the Chief of Staff and Executive Committee.
- Improve how intelligence is collected, assessed and shared across Quandela, using databases and automation tools where relevant.

CEO Office support

- Prepare briefings and materials for strategic meetings, investor and board discussions, institutional visits and media appearances.
- Help track company objectives and coordinate planning cycles with Executive Committee members.
- Coordinate selected projects involving teams such as Sales, Partnerships, Communications, Finance, HR and Operations.
- Take ownership of urgent research and execution topics led by the Chief of Staff.

Examples of projects led by previous interns

The scope changes with the company’s priorities. Recent projects have included:

- Building Quandela’s competitive intelligence system, including competitor profiles, market monitoring, internal databases and automated information flows.
- Mapping the investment fund landscape, contributing to fundraising strategy and structuring recurring communications with investors and board members.
- Assessing international markets, strategic partnerships and acquisition targets across Quandela’s value chain.
- Coordinating company-wide initiatives, including objective tracking, the annual OKR process and the deployment of AI tools and automated workflows across teams.
- Supporting a major corporate communications campaign and preparing leadership for strategic meetings, international summits, institutional delegations and media interviews.

These examples illustrate the range of the role rather than a fixed task list. Your projects will depend on Quandela’s priorities during the internship and on the areas where you can create the most value.

Requirements

We are looking for someone who is curious, rigorous, proactive and eager to learn quickly.

We welcome applicants from leading business, engineering and university programs, including HEC, ESSEC, ESCP, Sciences Po, ENS, École Polytechnique, Mines Paris, CentraleSupélec, LSE and Imperial, among others. - You are comfortable with spreadsheets and structured data. Experience with data analysis, Airtable or workflow automation is a plus.
- You are interested in deeptech, innovation and fast-growing companies. Prior knowledge of quantum computing is welcome but not required.

Benefits

- A highly educational and impactful role at the heart of one of Europe’s leading quantum computing companies.
- Direct exposure to the senior leaders and strategic decisions.

- An internship allowance of €1,200 to €1,400 per month.

postings.title: Technical Chief of Staff - Office of the CTO & CSO
postings.description:
Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation !

We are looking for a Technical Chief of Staff to the CTO and Chief Scientific Officer (CSO) to join the Office of the CTO & CSO and support the execution of Quandela’s technical and scientific strategy.

Working at the core of the company’s technical leadership, you will help structure priorities, coordinate strategic initiatives across research, product and engineering teams, and ensure alignment between long-term scientific objectives and operational execution.

This role is designed as a force multiplier for the CTO and CSO, enabling them to focus on scientific and technical leadership while ensuring that key initiatives, internal coordination and decision processes run smoothly.

As part of the Office of the CTO & CSO, the role provides direct exposure to the executive leadership team (COMEX) and involvement in shaping some of the company’s most strategic technical and scientific decisions.

The position operates at the intersection of research, engineering and product development, helping maintain clarity, alignment and execution discipline as the organization scales.

Impact in the First 12 Months

In this role, you will play a key part in strengthening the execution and coordination of Quandela’s technical and scientific strategy. During your first year, you are expected to:

Build alignment across research, product and engineering

- Develop a strong understanding of Quandela’s scientific and technical roadmap.

- Improve coordination mechanisms between research teams, product leadership and engineering.

Bring structure and visibility to key technical initiatives

- Implement clear tracking and governance for major technical and scientific programs.

- Ensure leadership has visibility on milestones, dependencies and risks.

Strengthen the Office of the CTO & CSO

- Contribute to structuring the operating model of the Office of the CTO & CSO, including leadership rhythms and technical reviews.

- Support preparation and follow-up of key leadership discussions and decision processes.

Accelerate cross-team execution

- Help resolve cross-team challenges impacting critical technical initiatives.

- Improve communication flows and coordination between research, product and engineering teams.

Support the scaling of the technical organization

- Assist the CTO/CPO and CSO in structuring processes and initiatives that allow the organization to scale while maintaining scientific and technical excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Support to Technical Leadership

- Support the CTO/CPO and CSO in structuring and driving Quandela’s technical and scientific priorities.

- Prepare strategic materials, technical briefings and leadership reviews.

- Help synthesize complex technical topics to facilitate decision-making at the leadership level.

Office of the CTO & CSO Operations

- Contribute to the functioning of the Office of the CTO & CSO by structuring leadership processes and coordination mechanisms.

- Support preparation and follow-up of technical leadership meetings, reviews and strategic discussions.

- Help maintain alignment across research, engineering and product leadership.

Program Governance & Coordination

- Track progress on key technical and scientific initiatives across the organization.

- Ensure visibility on milestones, dependencies and risks.

- Facilitate coordination between teams and support resolution of cross-team blockers.

Organizational Effectiveness (P1)

- Improve internal processes supporting technical and research operations.

- Structure communication flows between research teams and product and engineering teams

- Ensure structuration of the teams

- Help maintain alignment between scientific exploration and product development priorities.

Strategic Projects

- Lead or coordinate high-impact cross-functional initiatives on behalf of the CTO/CPO and CSO.

- Provide analytical and operational support on complex organizational or technical topics.

Requirements

Who Thrives in This Role

This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy operating at the intersection of advanced science, engineering execution and strategic coordination.

You will thrive in this position if you:

- Are comfortable navigating highly technical environments and interacting with leading scientists and engineers.

- Enjoy structuring complex problems and bringing clarity to ambiguous situations.

- Have a strong bias for execution and impact, with the ability to move initiatives forward across teams.

- Are able to earn trust quickly with senior technical leaders through rigor, discretion and sound judgment.

- Are motivated by the opportunity to contribute to the development of cutting-edge scientific and technological programs.

Profile

Experience

5+ years of experience in roles such as:

- Chief of Staff

- Technical Program Manager

- Strategy / operations in deeptech organizations

- Technology consulting

Experience working in research-driven environments, advanced technology companies, or deeptech startups is strongly preferred.

Education

- Advanced degree (MSc or PhD) in physics, computer science or a related technical field is required.

- A dual background combining engineering/science and business, management or project management (e.g. engineering degree plus business school, MBA, or equivalent training) is a strong plus.

Skills

- Exceptional structuring and synthesis capabilities

- Strong program and project coordination skills

- Ability to engage effectively with senior scientists and engineers

- Excellent written and verbal communication

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

Personal Qualities

- Highly organized and proactive

- Strong sense of ownership and discretion

- Comfortable operating in highly technical environments

- Ability to navigate complex organizations and evolving priorities

Benefits

Joining Quandela means contributing to the development of one of Europe’s leading quantum computing companies, at the frontier of photonic quantum technologies.

As part of the Office of the CTO & CSO, this role offers a unique opportunity to work at the center of the company’s scientific and technical leadership, gaining direct exposure to strategic decisions and helping shape the execution of cutting-edge research and engineering programs.

You will collaborate with world-class scientists and engineers while helping scale a fast-growing deeptech organization tackling some of the most challenging technological problems of our time.
